tasks.title: Announcement #58
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a university event.
tasks.transcript: Hello everyone. Just a quick reminder that the university's annual cultural night is happening this Friday beginning at 6 p.m. in the new Lowry Wing of the Student Center. The celebration will include musical performances, food and activities representing various international cultures. Many of your fellow students have volunteered their time to make the event a success. So be sure not to miss it. There are special door prizes for the first 50 students. So try to arrive early.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?

options.C: A reception at the new student center

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：Just a quick reminder that the university's annual cultural night is happening this Friday beginning at 6 p.m. in the new Lowry Wing of the Student Center. 选项分析： A. An international food festival 一场国际美食节。公告中提到活动包括食物，但这是一年一度的文化夜（annual cultural night），不仅仅是美食节，所以A选项错误。 B. A performance schedule 一份演出时间表。公告中没有给出具体的时间表，所以B选项错误。 C. A reception at the new student center 在新学生中心举办的招待会。公告中地点是新学生中心，但活动内容不只是一场招待会，而是文化庆祝活动，所以C选项错误。 D. An annual cultural celebration 一年一度的文化庆祝活动。公告明确宣布“annual cultural night”（年度文化之夜），并描述了多种文化相关的表演、食物和活动，所以D选项正确。

questions.stem: What does the speaker urge the listeners to do?

options.B: Arrive early enough to receive a prize
options.C: Volunteer their time at the event
options.D: Bring their own food to the event

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者敦促听众做什么？ 定位原文：There are special door prizes for the first 50 students. So try to arrive early. 选项分析： A. Join in the performances 参与表演。公告中只说有表演，没有敦促听众参与表演，所以A选项错误。 B. Arrive early enough to receive a prize 早点到达以便获得奖品。说话者明确说前50名学生有特别入场奖，让大家尽量早到，所以B选项正确。 C. Volunteer their time at the event 在活动中做志愿者。公告中提到已经有学生自愿贡献时间，但没有敦促听众去当志愿者，所以C选项错误。 D. Bring their own food to the event 自带食物到活动现场。公告中未提及自带食物，所以D选项错误。
